title: Ultimate Beneficial Owners Attestation
description: Attests the ultimate beneficial owners of a legal person and the nature of their ownership or control, as registered in a national business register (EWC WP3).

vct.description: Verifiable credential type identifier of the Ultimate Beneficial Owners attestation.

legal_person_name.description: Official current legal person name as registered in the business register.

legal_person_id.description: Unique ID for organisations in EUID structure.

ultimate_beneficial_owner.description: Details of the Ultimate Beneficial Owner(s) of the company.

natural_person_details.description: Details of the natural person representing the UBO.

family_name.description: Family name of the natural person representing the UBO.

first_name.description: First name of the natural person representing the UBO.

identifier.description: Unique identifier for the natural person representing the UBO.

birth_date.description: Date of birth of the natural person representing the UBO.

postal_address.description: Postal address of the natural person representing the UBO.

tax_domicile.description: Country of taxation of the natural person representing the UBO in the ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 standard.

is_alive.description: Indicates if the natural person representing the UBO is alive.

nationality.description: Citizenship of the natural person representing the UBO.

ownership_details.description: Details of the ownership of the UBO on the company.

nature_of_control.description: Nature of the interest held by the UBO in the company.

ownership_type.description: The type of ownership held by the UBO (direct, indirect or both).

ownership_percentage.description: The percentage of ownership held by the UBO in the company, either a number between 0 and 100 or a bracket.

registrable_date.description: Date when the UBO's interest was registered.

inactive_date.description: Date when the UBO's interest became inactive (if applicable).

last_change_date.description: Date when the UBO's interest was last changed.

iss.description: Issuer of the attestation, as an HTTPS URL that identifies the issuer.

iat.description: Time of issuance as a NumericDate (seconds since the Unix epoch).

nbf.description: Time before which the attestation is not valid, as a NumericDate.

exp.description: Time at which the attestation expires, as a NumericDate.

cnf.description: Confirmation claim that binds the attestation to the key of the holder (RFC 7800).

jwk.description: Public key of the holder as a JWK.

status.description: Reference to the Token Status List entry that carries the revocation status of the attestation.

idx.description: Index of the attestation in the status list.

uri.description: URI of the status list token.
